clips.title: The story
paras: Along the Hillsbrad beaches, a gruesome sack of Murloc Heads is gathered as proof of military action against local shore pests. Lieutenant Farren Orinelle hands the bundle to passing adventurers for delivery to Marshal Redpath in Southshore.

Southshore faces constant attacks from Syndicate outlaws, Forsaken skirmishers, and wild murlocs along the coast. Local officers must show town leaders that coastal threats are being culled to secure funding and favor. Lieutenant Farren Orinelle collects severed heads as proof, but finds the cargo distasteful. His squeamishness leads him to hand the sack to travelers instead of bringing the grisly evidence to Marshal Redpath himself.
